product_brief: Management layer for enterprise quantum readiness and cryptographic discovery.
pqc_support: Partial — press release only: helps organizations manage and demonstrate progress toward PQC readiness
pqc_capability_description: General availability; manages PQC readiness through cryptographic inventory, policy evaluation, remediation workflows, progress tracking, dashboards, API imports, and CBOM exports. No PQC algorithms are named.
pqc_roadmap_details: Organizations can adopt PQC where supported and use an incremental approach beginning with a critical application environment or infrastructure layer.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Consolidates and normalizes cryptographic data from DigiCert ONE, network scans, certificate lifecycle management platforms, key vaults, CSV files, and software or cryptographic bills of materials; exports inventory as cryptographic bills of materials.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Supports software or cryptographic bills of materials and exports inventory data as cryptographic bills of materials.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports policy-based prioritization, recommended remediation actions, change requests including Jira workflows, certificate lifecycle actions, ownership assignment, and progress tracking.
organizational_readiness: Requires accountable owners, cryptographic visibility, priorities, adoption of PQC where supported, and documentation of results during a multiyear transition.

evidence.PQC Support: DigiCert Quantum Central , part of the DigiCert ONE platform, that helps organizations manage and demonstrate progress toward post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Teams can bring together cryptographic data from multiple sources, apply their own security policies, initiate remediation workflows, assign ownership, and track progress from a central location.
evidence.PQC Roadmap Details: Organizations can make practical progress now by assigning accountable owners, establishing enough cryptographic visibility to set priorities, adopting PQC where supported and documenting results.

product_brief: A cryptographic discovery and quantum readiness solution for enterprise PQC migration planning.
pqc_support: Partial — press release only: discovers PQC exposure, assesses PQC risk, and prioritizes quantum migration planning.
pqc_capability_description: Announced as an early-access cryptographic discovery and quantum readiness solution. It identifies cryptographic assets and dependencies, creates a CBOM, assesses PQC exposure, prioritizes risk, and supports migration planning. No PQC algorithms or production implementation are stated.
architecture_type: Quantum Security Posture Management (QSPM) approach combining cryptographic discovery, risk prioritization, and certificate lifecycle management (CLM).
pqc_roadmap_details: Helps organizations assess PQC risk exposure, prioritize quantum migration planning, and define a migration path based on business impact and complexity.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Identifies and maps cryptographic assets and dependencies; creates a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM); identifies PQC exposure across the environment.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Creates a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) showing where cryptography exists and dependent systems and services.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Assesses exposure using business criticality, data sensitivity, dependencies, and migration complexity to prioritize a migration path.
organizational_readiness: Supports continuous quantum readiness and long-term crypto agility.

evidence.PQC Support: Sectigo Quantum Ready ™ helps organizations discover all cryptographic assets, prioritize quantum risk and plan PQC migrations.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Sectigo Quantum Ready™ provides discovery and risk assessment capabilities
evidence.PQC Roadmap Details: Plan: Prioritize risk and define a practical migration path based on business impact and complexity.
